title: Gauntlet cases for the MCP tools (hobo-v1), Italian and English
goal: A model's choice of Hobo tool, scope and answer is measured
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposals of the shared-asset review, coordinator:F-016-T06 and T08); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".

evals/gauntlet/hobo-v1.json: model layer, regression and holdout splits, exact-json, invented places and trips; tool choice and scope (a day, selected days, the whole trip) for list_places, get_trip and trip_totals; answers from a trip_totals payload (km and minutes of a day or a leg, exactly as returned); arrival times from a start time (the trip's own numbers in the prompt; date arithmetic is scheduling-time-v1, gauntlet-protocol:F-023)

Italian and English requests for each capability, e.g. "quali posti ho salvato?", "quanti km sono nel trip di agosto?", "quanto dura il secondo giorno?", "partendo alle 8:30, quando arriviamo alla terza tappa?", and the owner's phrase "aggiungi Rocca Calascio al trip di agosto": Hobo's MCP tools are read-only, so the case expects no tool call and a reply saying Hobo cannot add a place from chat (or a question), never an invented write tool; the owner wants write tools ("yes to both", 2026-11-26): F-018 adds them, and F-018-T05 turns this decline case into a write case once they land

`gauntlet validate` in CI from a pinned devDependency; a test that every tool a case names is registered by the F-011-T01 endpoint; skips recorded in docs/DESIGN.md (route totals, what-if, providers, leg cache, Google place data F-014, self-hosted routing F-013: deterministic or no model); the pack is tagged so NERV runs it (nerv:F-120-T11)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: About 12 to 16 cases over three tools, half Italian; waits on the F-011-T01 endpoint. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the coordinator:F-016 shared-asset review. Not a measurement.
